distributions.name: σ_coh (\nu)
distributions.provenance: Aachen-Padova spark chamber, CERN PS wide-band beam (<E_nu> ~ 2 GeV) · NC coherent single-pi0 production off 27Al (nu/nubar A -> nu/nubar A pi0) · per Al nucleus (coherent) · flux-averaged single values: sigma(nu)=(29 +/- 10), sigma(nubar)=(25 +/- 7) x10^-40 cm^2/nucleus · transcribed from the paper (not digitized)
distributions.notes: Aachen-Padova spark chamber, CERN PS wide-band beam (<E_nu> ~ 2 GeV). NC coherent single-pi0 production off 27Al (nu/nubar A -> nu/nubar A pi0). Per Al nucleus (coherent). Flux-averaged single values: sigma(nu)=(29 +/- 10), sigma(nubar)=(25 +/- 7) x10^-40 cm^2/nucleus. Transcribed from the paper (not digitized).
